name: status_forge
title: StatusForge
description: 离线 HTTP 状态码速查：覆盖 1xx–5xx 共 60+ 状态码，支持数字 / 关键词搜索与分类筛选。
core:
var STATUS = {
 100:{n:'Continue',d:'请求已收到，继续处理'},
 101:{n:'Switching Protocols',d:'切换协议（如升级 WebSocket）'},
 102:{n:'Processing',d:'WebDAV：正在处理'},
 103:{n:'Early Hints',d:'响应头提前推送（103）'},
 200:{n:'OK',d:'请求成功'},
 201:{n:'Created',d:'已创建资源'},
 202:{n:'Accepted',d:'已接受待处理'},
 203:{n:'Non-Authoritative',d:'非权威信息'},
 204:{n:'No Content',d:'成功但无返回内容'},
 205:{n:'Reset Content',d:'重置内容'},
 206:{n:'Partial Content',d:'分片下载 / 范围请求'},
 207:{n:'Multi-Status',d:'WebDAV：多状态'},
 208:{n:'Already Reported',d:'WebDAV：已报告'},
 226:{n:'IM Used',d:'实例操作已应用'},
 300:{n:'Multiple Choices',d:'多路选择'},
 301:{n:'Moved Permanently',d:'永久重定向'},
 302:{n:'Found',d:'临时重定向（语义混用）'},
 303:{n:'See Other',d:'见其它位置（POST→GET）'},
 304:{n:'Not Modified',d:'缓存未变更'},
 305:{n:'Use Proxy',d:'已废弃：需经代理'},
 307:{n:'Temporary Redirect',d:'临时重定向（方法不变）'},
 308:{n:'Permanent Redirect',d:'永久重定向（方法不变）'},
 400:{n:'Bad Request',d:'请求语法错误'},
 401:{n:'Unauthorized',d:'未认证'},
 402:{n:'Payment Required',d:'预留：需付费'},
 403:{n:'Forbidden',d:'无权限（已认证但拒绝）'},
 404:{n:'Not Found',d:'资源不存在'},
 405:{n:'Method Not Allowed',d:'方法不被允许'},
 406:{n:'Not Acceptable',d:'无法生成可接受响应'},
 407:{n:'Proxy Auth Required',d:'需代理认证'},
 408:{n:'Request Timeout',d:'请求超时'},
 409:{n:'Conflict',d:'资源冲突（如 PUT 版本）'},
 410:{n:'Gone',d:'资源已永久删除'},
 411:{n:'Length Required',d:'需 Content-Length'},
 412:{n:'Precondition Failed',d:'前置条件失败'},
 413:{n:'Payload Too Large',d:'负载过大'},
 414:{n:'URI Too Long',d:'URI 过长'},
 415:{n:'Unsupported Media',d:'媒体类型不支持'},
 416:{n:'Range Not Satisfiable',d:'范围不可满足'},
 417:{n:'Expectation Failed',d:'Expect 头不满足'},
 418:{n:"I'm a teapot",d:'彩蛋：我是一个茶壶（RFC 2324）'},
 421:{n:'Misdirected',d:'请求发错服务器'},
 422:{n:'Unprocessable',d:'语义正确但无法处理'},
 423:{n:'Locked',d:'WebDAV：已锁定'},
 424:{n:'Failed Dependency',d:'WebDAV：依赖失败'},
 425:{n:'Too Early',d:'过早（重放风险）'},
 426:{n:'Upgrade Required',d:'需升级协议'},
 428:{n:'Precondition Required',d:'需前置条件'},
 429:{n:'Too Many Requests',d:'限流'},
 431:{n:'Unavailable For Legal',d:'因法律不可用'},
 451:{n:'Unavailable For Legal (Censored)',d:'因法律原因下线（审查）'},
 500:{n:'Internal Server Error',d:'服务器内部错误'},
 501:{n:'Not Implemented',d:'未实现'},
 502:{n:'Bad Gateway',d:'网关错误'},
 503:{n:'Service Unavailable',d:'服务不可用（过载 / 维护）'},
 504:{n:'Gateway Timeout',d:'网关超时'},
 505:{n:'HTTP Version Not Supported',d:'HTTP 版本不支持'},
 506:{n:'Variant Also Negotiates',d:'变体协商错误'},
 507:{n:'Insufficient Storage',d:'WebDAV：存储不足'},
 508:{n:'Loop Detected',d:'WebDAV：检测到环路'},
 510:{n:'Not Extended',d:'需扩展'},
 511:{n:'Network Auth Required',d:'需网络认证（captive portal）'}
};
function catOf(code){ var d=Math.floor(code/100); return d===1?'信息':d===2?'成功':d===3?'重定向':d===4?'客户端错误':'服务器错误'; }
function getStatus(code){ var e=STATUS[code]; return e?{code:code,name:e.n,desc:e.d,cat:catOf(code)}:null; }
function searchStatus(q){
  q=String(q||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  var keys=Object.keys(STATUS).map(Number).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
  if(/^\d+$/.test(q)) return keys.filter(function(k){return String(k).indexOf(q)===0;}).map(getStatus);
  if(!q) return keys.map(getStatus);
  return keys.filter(function(k){ var e=STATUS[k]; return (e.n.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0)||(e.d.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0); }).map(getStatus);
}
function listByCat(cat){ return searchStatus('').filter(function(s){return s.cat===cat;}); }
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
  module.exports={STATUS:STATUS,catOf:catOf,getStatus:getStatus,searchStatus:searchStatus,listByCat:listByCat};
}
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.StatusForgePure={STATUS:STATUS,catOf:catOf,getStatus:getStatus,searchStatus:searchStatus,listByCat:listByCat};
}
